messages:
maria: Heads-up — after the entitlement-evaluator batching change landed in staging, console scope previews are showing negative remaining quota for some scoped tokens. attaching short logs.
jamie: repro steps?
maria: curl to staging evaluator with tenant-scoped token + wildcard scope. quick example:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer tenant-42-token' \
  'https://staging-eval.redwood/api/v1/evaluate?scope=project:*' 
```
logs:
```
WARN quota check - tenant=tenant-42 scope=project:* consumed=2 remaining=-1 evaluator.batch=3
```
taylor: batching window is 50ms now, right? Could be merging requests with different scope-expansions.
alex: suspect root cause: when scope expands (project:* -> project:1,project:2) the batcher dedups keys incorrectly and counts per-expanded-scope twice in quota accounting. hitting a race in the aggregator.
sasha: console preview calls the same evaluator but with cache=preview; if caching interacts with batching that could make counts off for short-lived tokens.
liam: can we confirm it's only preview traffic and not API traffic from customers? sre-oncall: current alerts only from staging. no prod spikes yet.
maria: yes staging-only so far. but want to be safe before we flip flag to 100%.
alex: quick mitigation: add telemetry metric evaluator.batch_size and evaluator.duplicate_scope_count so we can see how often expansion causes extra counts. plus a canary fallback: if duplicate_scope_count > 0.05 for a tenant, force single-eval path for that tenant.
jamie: agree. also add a counter for quota_adjustments where remaining < 0 so UX can catch-it and show safe fallback in console preview.
taylor: perf tradeoff: single-eval increases token-cost and latency. we should gate fallback behind rollout and only apply to preview endpoints (console) initially.
sasha: small UX tweak: when preview fails quota sanity checks, show "preview may be approximate" tooltip instead of error page.
liam: who's owning telemetry + rollout plan?
maria: I'll open an issue with steps and add owner. tentative plan: telemetry PR -> alpha flag (5% tenants) -> observe 48h -> extend -> apply fallback to previews -> decide on larger rollback if metrics bad.
jamie: can we also add a unit test that simulates expansion + batching boundary to prevent regression?
alex: yes I'll add aggregator test + integration scenario for scope expansion.
sre-oncall: ping me when canary starts, I'll watch for alert noise and throttle if needed.
deploy-bot: rolled entitlement-evaluator v3.2.0 to staging @ 1784012350 :package:
maria: thanks. action items: (1) alex: test and quick fix for dedupe logic, (2) maria: issue + telemetry counters, (3) jamie: add unit/integration test, (4) taylor/sasha: console UX fallback copy. aim to have PRs by EOD tomorrow.
liam: lgtm. :thumbsup:
